review_evidence: Reviewed the 124-file LeanCourse24 snapshot and lecture/assignment inventory.
The primary files contain course lectures, assignments, before/after variants, examples, definitions, and proofs across Lean and mathematics.
Course and exercise roles do not make formal content disposable; no content-level selector was shown to be lossless.
summary: Retain LeanCourse24 as a substantial instructional Lean formalization corpus.
